**From:** Communications <comms@morecheese.example>
**To:** Membership Operations <membership.ops@morecheese.example>
**Sent:** Monday, 4 February 2019 09:12
**Subject:** January close — numbers for Friday's post

> **FICTIONAL DEMONSTRATION DOCUMENT** — International Cheese Federation (ICF), a fictitious trade association created for the MemberJunction More Cheese demonstration environment. All names, figures, events, and decisions are invented.

Morning —

Friday's post is the advocacy piece on the federal data backlog. The whole argument is that members
plan a year at a time and can't do that when the statistics go quiet, so it would land much harder
if I could say how many producers we're speaking for.

Can you give me a member count as of 31 January that I can put in print? One number, and I'll
describe it however you tell me to describe it. I need it by Thursday lunchtime to get the post
through review.

Also — Wednesday's spotlight is Henri Dubois, the affineur in the Jura who joined last month.
Nothing needed from you unless his record has something odd on it.

Thanks,
*Communications*
